Application Data.NAME: Antique Treasures Gallery
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Main St Suite 4B, Historic District, Savannah, GA 31401-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Antique Treasures Gallery specializes in the retail of high-quality antique furniture, collectibles, vintage jewelry, and home decor items. With a focus on offering unique pieces that cater to collectors and home decorators, the gallery provides personalized customer service, ensuring each item is carefully curated and well-presented. Our operations include maintaining a robust inventory management system, complete with documented provenance for each antique, to support authenticity and value. Additionally, the gallery is located in the Historic District of Savannah, a high-traffic area frequented by tourists and locals alike, enhancing foot traffic and sales stability. Security measures include a monitored alarm system and CCTV to prevent theft and damage, alongside staff training on loss prevention and customer engagement.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, our gallery experienced a burglary incident where several antique items were stolen, valued at $3,500. The claim was submitted, and we received a settlement of $3,500. The case was closed, and the status is resolved. Additionally, on 06/10/2023, there was water damage due to a leaky roof during heavy rain, which caused damage to some collectibles, amounting to $1,500. We are currently in the process of filing a claim for this incident, and the status is pending.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored alarm system with CCTV, on-site watchpersons during high-traffic hours, and secured display cases for valuable items.
